warning: service syncthing: healthcheck was dropped: an image's healthcheck is not run, and nothing waits for it
note: version is ignored
note: service syncthing: container_name is ignored: the instance is named for the service, which is the name siblings use
note: service syncthing: hostname is ignored: the instance is named for the service, which is the name siblings use
note: service syncthing: bind mount /wherever/st-sync is mounted as it is: files owned by a host user show up as "nobody" in the container, so the app can read it but probably not write to it. Add :ro if it only reads, or :shift to map the ids (needs idmapped-mount support on that filesystem)
